tasks.label: Paper: full compile to PDF (pdflatex+bibtex)
tasks.command: cd ${workspaceFolder}/paper && pdflatex -interaction=nonstopmode main.tex >/dev/null 2>&1 && bibtex main >/dev/null 2>&1 && pdflatex -interaction=nonstopmode main.tex >/dev/null 2>&1 && pdflatex -interaction=nonstopmode main.tex && echo '=== done: paper/main.pdf ==='

tasks.label: Paper: quick compile (pdflatex once)
tasks.command: cd ${workspaceFolder}/paper && pdflatex -interaction=nonstopmode main.tex && echo '=== quick compile done: paper/main.pdf ==='

tasks.label: Paper: clean intermediates
tasks.command: cd ${workspaceFolder}/paper && rm -f main.aux main.bbl main.blg main.log main.out main.pdf && echo '=== cleaned paper build artifacts ==='
